story.logline: A covert swordsman enters a guarded estate to confront an old ally whose loyalty has changed, forcing a violent test of identity and allegiance.
story.theme: friendship, loyalty and identity under pressure
story.character_goal: Shinzo must complete the infiltration and confront Kenji.
story.obstacle: The guarded estate, armed opposition and Kenji's changed allegiance.
story.turning_choice: Shinzo abandons the safer firearm approach and accepts a direct sword confrontation.
